corrections must remain distinguishable from the tested executable source.

seven regressions, zero failures, cancellations, skips or todos. The
[final result review](reviews/compact-font-40-result.md) closes native/backend/

historical font controls and actual generated-card TED workflows at 40/80.
The [complete offer](evidence/ks48-strict-successor-result/OFFER.md) supplies

retain their names and CALL/RET boundaries. ABI remains 5.1 and the PICO record
remains version 3. This is not the later debugger-support interface.

preserving supported wider/narrow modes. The book must verify its new opening
and BANNER route, then refresh final citations and navigation. Existing pins
remain until those decisions. Screen-related boot state now reflects width 40,
so receiving exit/reference checks must run at their declared configuration.
All evidence is from host models. No hardware, publication or deployment is
included.

the reset jump followed by the numbered-call interface. Read-only data and
code follow, with a single free gap at the end (`src/reset.asm:1-14`,
`src/abi.asm:12-20`, `src/rom.asm:1-17`, `src/end.asm:1-4`). The historical
`78127ec` image had these regions:

| Addresses | Bytes | Region |
| --- | ---: | --- |
| `C000h–C002h` | 3 | Reset jump |
| `C003h–C00Ah` | 8 | ROM interface |
| `C00Bh–C609h` | 1,535 | Read-only data |
| `C60Ah–FE91h` | 14,472 | Code |
| `FE92h–FFFFh` | 366 | Free |

Its used extent was 16,018 of 16,384 bytes. These figures describe that
historical image, not newly measured positions at `ea3ef3d`. The census
stores each region's start and exclusive end while the table above prints
the last occupied address (`tools/build.mjs:272-287`).
